completion:
local Player = {}
Player.__index = Player

function Player.new(name: string, health: number)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Player)
	self.name = name
	self.health = health
	return self
end

function Player:takeDamage(amount: number)
	self.health = math.max(0, self.health - amount)
end

return Player

prompt: Write a Luau function that returns the maximum value in an array.
completion:
local function findMax(values: {number}): number
	local max = values[1]
	for _, v in ipairs(values) do
		if v > max then
			max = v
		end
	end
	return max
end

Create a simple Luau debounce function to prevent spamming an action.
completion:
local function debounce(fn: () -> ()): () -> ()
	local isRunning = false
	return function()
		if isRunning then
			return
		end
		isRunning = true
		fn()
		task.wait(1)
		isRunning = false
	end
end
